text_block_list.text:
In the generation just above Marvelous 
Sunday, Narita Brian dominated the Satsuki 
Sho and Japanese Derby with overwhelming 
strength.

While the Umamusume around her were losing 
their confidence, Marvelous Sunday told 
them that the existence of such a 
"monster" was marvelous in itself.

Today wasn't the only time she went around 
spreading "Marvelous." She was like an 
evangelist, constantly striving to share a 
brilliant, shining world with others.

With her sights set on the "World 
Marvelous Project," she first aimed to 
start strong with a great result in the 
Make a Debut race.
